description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR4. Types::runtime_type_predicate (mod.rs ~1765) builds an eagerly materialised finite RuntimeTypePredicate tree; a μ type has no value in it, and eight consumers inherit it (executable_facts, callsite_dispatch, jobs/native, jobs/transport, jobs/body, jobs/semantic). Decide with evidence: the predicate grows a recursive node, or the dispatch surface stays ground by construction and the μ is projected away at that boundary. Adjacent: jobs/transport.rs ~2410 generic_layout_from_demand recurses forever under ShapeDemand::Whole and ~2604 boundary_runtime_demand recurses unguarded. Tests: runtime_type_predicate_of_a_recursive_denotation_is_finite; three-door parity on return_tuple_ladder.
title: A recursive denotation at the runtime-dispatch boundary
